known_issues.summary: One-sided thermal connection on C10/C11 (GND pad solid to the F.Cu pour, JOY_X/JOY_Y pad on a 0.20 mm trace) and on the four J1 GND through-hole pins (solid on three copper layers): tombstoning and barrel-fill risk; narrower-spoke repair tracked in #7295
USB D+/D- pair on In2.Cu (the VCC plane layer) measures 71.6 ohm differential against the 90 ohm spec in project.kct; not ready until #7250 is fixed
